files.description: Full text of paper 'Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision' (arXiv:2212.04356v1). Primary evidence source. Contains main text, all tables (1-19), figure captions, appendices A-F, and references.
Official GitHub README for the Whisper repository. Contains model table with VRAM/speed info, command-line usage examples, and Python API examples. Consistent with paper claims.

notes: All result-bearing evidence is contained in paper.txt. README_1.md provides supplementary context on model sizes and deployment. No raw logs, training data, or additional experimental files.
